scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const copy=(s,d,f)=>{fs.mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true});for(const e of fs.readdirSync(s,{withFileTypes:true})){const sp=path.join(s,e.name);const dp=path.join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory())copy(sp,dp,f);else if(e.isFile()&&f(e.name)){fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(dp),{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(sp,dp)}}};copy(path.resolve('web'),path.resolve('dist','web'),n=>n.endsWith('.css'));copy(path.resolve('locales'),path.resolve('dist','locales'),n=>n.endsWith('.json'));copy(path.resolve('assets'),path.resolve('dist','assets'),n=>n.endsWith('.woff')||n.endsWith('.woff2'));console.log('[common] Copied CSS, locales, and fonts');"
scripts.watch:assets: chokidar "web/**/*.css" "locales/**/*.json" "assets/**/*.{woff,woff2}" -c "node -e \"const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const copy=(s,d,f)=>{fs.mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true});for(const e of fs.readdirSync(s,{withFileTypes:true})){const sp=path.join(s,e.name);const dp=path.join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory())copy(sp,dp,f);else if(e.isFile()&&f(e.name)){fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(dp),{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(sp,dp)}}};copy(path.resolve('web'),path.resolve('dist','web'),n=>n.endsWith('.css'));copy(path.resolve('locales'),path.resolve('dist','locales'),n=>n.endsWith('.json'));copy(path.resolve('assets'),path.resolve('dist','assets'),n=>n.endsWith('.woff')||n.endsWith('.woff2'));console.log('[common] Copied CSS, locales, and fonts');\""
